newsitem.title: JAPAN: U.S. Treasuries mixed, slightly supported in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries mixed, slightly supported in Tokyo.

text.p: U.S. Treasuries were narrowly mixed by Tokyo midday on Friday, with light short-covering providing overall price support following New York's falls.

Traders said downward pressure persisted, with that mood expected to continue in the short term until the market sees the results of a series of influential U.S. economic indicators scheduled for next week.

News that Japan's Ministry of Finance had ordered Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co to halt its operations may weigh on Treasury prices due to speculation the insurer may unload its foreign bond positions, traders said.

"The market is not worried about Nissan as the amount of its foreign bond holding is not believed to be large enough to affect Treasury prices, but the market was concerned whether other Japanese life insurers were in trouble," a trader said.
"Such a concern could be a factor to induce speculative sales and weigh heavily on prices," he said.
The key 6-5/8 percent 30-year bond was unchanged at 93-25/32, yielding 7.13 percent, from Thursday's New York.
The June T-bond futures contract fell 2/32 from the previous close to 107-8/32. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-3-3432-8785
